reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) does not address ALD alumina coatings, their oxygen barrier properties, or their effect on HfNbTaTiZr. E1 describes TEM sample preparation of a different alloy, and E2 discusses corrosion passivation in acid, not high-temperature oxidation resistance. The key premises are therefore unsupported by the provided citations.
premises: ALD can deposit ultrathin, dense, adherent Al2O3 coatings on metallic alloys.
Al2O3 coatings have low oxygen diffusivity and can act as oxygen barriers at 1000 °C.
The ALD coating process (~300 °C) will not alter the microstructure of the cast HfNbTaTiZr alloy.
Preventing oxygen ingress will preserve the alloy's intrinsic ductility and high-temperature strength.
